subject.title: Feishu DM: MEDIA: attachment silently fails; streaming-card discard drops the image

question: Which path should own this Feishu media-loss report before more automation runs: the open read-tool media bridge, the open Feishu upload fix, or one consolidated Feishu DM proof/fix pass?
rationale: Current main still has multiple source-visible gaps, while the linked PRs cover only slices of the reported behavior and need maintainer consolidation rather than another unsupervised duplicate fix lane.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Pending PR Review
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the open partial PRs and require one live Feishu DM proof path before closing the umbrella.

options.title: Split To Narrow Owners
options.body: Route the read-tool image part to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41744 and the upload part to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95291, then close this only after those paths merge or are disproven.

options.title: Sponsor Consolidated Fix
options.body: Ask one owner to produce a single Feishu DM end-to-end fix/proof branch covering direct `MEDIA:`, read-tool images, and streaming-card finalization.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Pending PR Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the open partial PRs and require one live Feishu DM proof path before closing the umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata identifies @m1heng as the community owner for this plugin surface.
